defects.description: Rebuild ignores lookup authority and publishes a partial snapshot when one dependency returns unsuccessful empty records, silently discarding routes from the previous complete snapshot.

trigger.input: Supply a lookup, publish a complete east/west snapshot, select west, then rebuild with east updated and west returning {ok:false,records:[]}; read routes.
trigger.expected: Rebuild false; the previous west route remains available and the persisted complete snapshot is unchanged.
trigger.actual: Rebuild true; the west routes disappear and the partial east-only snapshot replaces the stored snapshot.

defects.why_missed: The suite only uses the successful default lookup. It contains no dependency adapter, unsuccessful response or second rebuild.

defects.description: A new catalog reloads the snapshot but ignores the persisted selection, routing through the first backend rather than the backend selected by its predecessor.

trigger.input: Use a shared Map, rebuild, select west, then construct another Catalog with that Map and read its routes without rebuilding.
trigger.expected: The new instance routes through west.
trigger.actual: The new instance routes through east despite selected=west in the store.

defects.why_missed: The suite changes selection within one instance using the default private store. No persistent-store fixture or reconstruction scenario exists.
